# Benchmark photos

Real photos the LLM benchmarks give the agent, so cropping is judged on a real scene rather than a drawing.

- `farmhouse.jpg`: a farmhouse in a field at sunrise, 1600×1000. Photo by Philipp Reiner, [Unsplash](https://unsplash.com/photos/qPJ6eRAMmCM), under the Unsplash License; fetched through Lorem Picsum (id 206).
